{{Quote|A visitor sir... His name is Slyder&mdash;he regrets the intrusion&mdash;but insists on seeing you.|The droid shows Governor Donar his final guest|<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>}}
A '''[[Butler droid/Legends|butler droid]]''' was owned by the family of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Dol Donar II]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] was tasked with allowing guests to meet with he governor. The droid was required to wear a formal vest over his plating and sometimes emulated a coughing sound when he thought that he was interrupting.

During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] accompanied the family to the luxury [[Starship/Legends|starship]], ''[[Star of Empire]]'', where the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Slyder]] insisted on seeing the governor.

The droid remained on the ''Star'' with [[Rissa Donar|Lady Rissa]] when the governor, his son [[Nathan Donar III]], and Slyder disembarked the luxury ship to pursue a band of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]]. All three were killed when Donar's [[Dol Donar's yacht|yacht]] was destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
The droid is briefly mentioned in the ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'' novel. In the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio drama]] the droid's line is delivered by an uncredited [[Human/Legends|human]] voice, presumably a biological [[butler]] of the Governor.
